data: Audit scope: DeepSeek (Blue Whale AI) financials vs SEC documentary requirements. Auditor: Blue Whale AI / Sovereign Auditor Protocol™. No SEC registration or filing found as of 2026-08.

Finding: No S-1, F-1, prospectus, or issuer filing exists for DeepSeek, Hangzhou DeepSeek, or High-Flyer. Only third-party Form N-1A (Themes ETF Trust) references DeepSeek. Compliance status: outside SEC reporting regime.

Finding: Revenue RMB 475M (~$70.7M); Net Loss RMB 715M; Overall Gross Margin 44.6%; API Gross Margin 82.9%. Source: anonymous citations (The Information) and third-party filings (Anhui Korun). Not audited, not SEC-filed.
Finding: Anhui Korun filing implies ~$52B valuation (0.8265% stake for RMB 2.9B). Pre-IPO round targets ~$75B. No official valuation confirmed by DeepSeek.
Risk: AI infrastructure spend ~RMB 11B (Jan–Jul 2026) vs revenue RMB 475M. Estimated annual depreciation RMB 1.4–2.2B exceeds total revenue. No SEC risk-factor disclosure exists.
Finding: CITIC Securities engaged as sponsor for Shanghai STAR Market listing targeted 2027. No prospectus filed; no official announcement. SEC documentary requirements remain unmet.

Conclusion: DeepSeek operates entirely outside SEC reporting. Financials are unaudited, sourced from leaks and third-party filings. No S-1, no prospectus, no audited statements. IPO preparation indicates future regulated disclosure, but current SEC documentary requirements are not met.
